verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly shows native in-tool conversation. Agent-focused docs mention messaging in item 'updates' and '@mention them in any conversation', which implies threaded conversations exist inside monday where work is planned. Slack and Teams integrations bring in external chat tools, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing team-to-team chat or update threads, real-time messaging details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of in-tool team communication.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can chat with my team directly inside the same tool I plan work in

citations.quote: Message them in updates, assign them items, and @mention them in any conversation to kick off real work — replies, statuses, and follow-ups included.
